SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth AS age_at_condition_start,
    gc.concept_name AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM
    `condition_occurrence` AS co
JOIN
    `person` AS p
ON
    co.person_id = p.person_id
JOIN
    `concept` AS gc
ON
    p.gender_concept_id = gc.concept_id
WHERE
    co.condition_concept_id IN (75053, 75634, 136834, 436209)
GROUP BY
    age_at_condition_start,
    gender
ORDER BY
    age_at_condition_start,
    gender;

The evaluator's feedback highlights a crucial point regarding the comprehensive identification of "closed hip fracture." My previous approach using a static list of concepts was indeed incomplete. To address this, I will revise the SQL query to leverage the `concept_ancestor` table, allowing for a more robust and exhaustive inclusion of all relevant descendant concepts.

Specifically, "hip fracture" is most commonly understood as a fracture of the proximal femur. Therefore, I will identify all concepts that are descendants of "Fracture of femur" (`concept_id = 442560`) AND are also descendants of "Closed fracture" (`concept_id = 4307254`). This intersection will provide a comprehensive set of "closed femur fracture" concepts, which aligns well with the clinical definition of a closed hip fracture.

args.sql_query:
SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth AS age_at_condition_start,
    gc.concept_name AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM
    `condition_occurrence` AS co
JOIN
    `person` AS p
ON
    co.person_id = p.person_id
JOIN
    `concept` AS gc
ON
    p.gender_concept_id = gc.concept_id
WHERE
    co.condition_concept_id IN (
        SELECT ca_femur.descendant_concept_id
        FROM `concept_ancestor` AS ca_femur
        WHERE ca_femur.ancestor_concept_id = 442560 -- Fracture of femur
        INTERSECT
        SELECT ca_closed.descendant_concept_id
        FROM `concept_ancestor` AS ca_closed
        WHERE ca_closed.ancestor_concept_id = 4307254 -- Closed fracture
    )
GROUP BY
    age_at_condition_start,
    gender
ORDER BY
    age_at_condition_start,
    gender;
